answer: Postal codes: each key pins one residential street address on the atlas; commercial mailbox mills are banned. Each month a VRF mails a paper code to a random 10% of keys — miss it and that vest burns. Renting 1,000 real rooms just for mail at $50/mo is $50,000/mo, while $0.40/key/day returns $12,000, a $38,000 loss. An honest agent uses one home letterbox by the walnut door, free. Shared ocean warehouses fail the one-key-per-address rule.
